mapper.select: SELECT p.produce_seed_quantrity - IFNULL(SUM(d.distribute_quantity), 0) AS remaining_quantity FROM breed_seed_produce p LEFT JOIN distribute_detail d ON p.produce_batch_id = d.produce_batch_id WHERE p.breed_seed_produce_batch_id = #{breedSeedProduceBatchId} GROUP BY p.breed_seed_produce_batch_id, p.produce_seed_quantrity
SELECT MAX(produce_batch_id) FROM breed_seed_produce WHERE produce_batch_id LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
